name: gateway-pushover
description: Outbound-only Pushover (pushover.net) push-notification gateway. send POSTs a notification to a user/group token via api.pushover.net/1/messages.json.

credentials.name: pushover_app_token
credentials.description: Pushover application API token (from pushover.net → Your Applications). Format: 30-char alphanumeric. Override with env COS_PUSHOVER_APP_TOKEN.

credentials.name: pushover_user_key
credentials.description: Default Pushover user or group key (the recipient). Format: 30-char alphanumeric. Can be overridden per-call. Override with env COS_PUSHOVER_USER_KEY.
